prompt: Use case: stylized-concept with realistic animal anatomy and photoreal fantasy materials. Make ONE contact plate of THREE DISTINCT LEGENDARY CREATURE CONCEPTS for the SAME species, three columns A,B,C with two rows. Row1 each concept faces towards the viewer with substantial side profile; row2 show the corresponding SAME concept facing away. Camera looks down approximately30degrees from horizontal, near-orthographic long lens, model yaw towards/away approximately±34degrees from side profile. Whole creature INCLUDING tail, ears, palms, extended membranes and magic signature must fit each cell with ample margins. Plain light neutral grey ground, no landscape, text, grid labels, environment or interface. Adult elder creatures, NEVER cute juvenile toys. Maintain recognisable natural family, ancient wisdom/power, wear/scars and bold distinctive silhouette, not just scale. Each column must actually differ in its PRIMARY signature; age-grizzle is not the signature. Ed's rule fit+variety: crystal/flame/spirit-wings permitted when justified, no shared legendary uniform. Optional offerings physically fit the animal. Use no generic crown on every concept. Species: squirrel. Area story: Twiggy forest: small leafy plants, many thin-trunk saplings and straight but slanted multi-trunk trees. Concept A (left): The Coppice Archivist: very old red squirrel with enormously enlarged question-mark bushy tail, several real-sized acorn offerings caught within distinct tufts as if a living ancestral store, weathered ear tufts, grey muzzle, powerful haunches and delicate grasping forepaws; tail is the signature, no crystals and no horns. Concept B (middle): The Seed-Armoured Guardian: aged red squirrel with enlarged orange incisors and powerful hindquarters, three overlapping weathered acorn-cup shoulder plates as small natural armour, scarred paws gripping one luminous seed, tail ordinary but bushy; no human knight uniform. Concept C (right): The Twig Runner: ancient lean red squirrel in spring-loaded grounded crouch, exaggerated long hind feet, old scar lines along haunches, three soft displaced red-fur afterimages taper immediately from its real tail, no extra bodies, no wings. Ear tufts and pale belly stay clear.
